products.name: Broadsheet Check Shirt
products.description: A cotton shirt in a blue-and-black check, cut for everyday wear. The weave holds a crisp line at the collar and cuff without feeling stiff. Layer it under a coat or wear it alone on a mild day.

products.name: Broadsheet Plaid Shirt
products.description: A brushed cotton plaid cut for layering, in muted red and navy. The collar holds its shape without starch, and the body is roomy enough to wear open over a tee. Warm enough for a cold newsroom, light enough to keep on all day.

products.name: Dispatch Short-Sleeve Shirt
products.description: A short-sleeve shirt in sky blue brushed cotton, cut straight through the body for a relaxed fit. The lightweight weave breathes in warm weather, and the collar sits flat under a jacket if the evening turns cool. Built for the last hot week of the season.

products.name: Gazette Check Shirt
products.description: A cotton check shirt in charcoal and white, buttoned through with a spread collar. The fabric has enough weight to hold a crease but stays soft against the skin. Reads sharp at a desk, easy after hours.

products.name: Indigo Frock
products.description: A fit-and-flare frock in indigo cotton, gathered at the waist with a full skirt. The fabric has a slight drape that moves when you walk, and the sleeves are cut short for warm days. An easy piece for a long afternoon on your feet.

products.name: Summer Issue Dress
products.description: A sleeveless summer dress in pale yellow cotton, cut loose through the body with a tie at the waist. The fabric is light enough to wear through a full day of heat and packs down small for travel. Made for warm mornings and long light.

products.name: Column Dress, Ash
products.description: A sleeveless button-through dress in ash-grey crepe, belted at the waist with a self tie. The A-line skirt falls below the knee and moves well. Reads as tailored, wears as easy.

products.name: Quarto Short Frock
products.description: A short frock in burgundy cotton-blend, fitted through the bodice with a flared skirt that stops above the knee. The fabric has a slight stretch for movement, and the neckline sits square across the collarbone. A compact piece for an evening out.

products.name: Tartan Folio Dress
products.description: A long-sleeve dress in red-and-navy tartan wool-blend, fitted at the waist with a pleated skirt. The wool content holds warmth through a cold commute, and the pleats keep their shape through the day. A dress built for a proper autumn.

products.name: Nocturne Gown
products.description: A floor-length gown in black satin, cut close through the bodice and falling loose to the hem. The fabric catches light without shine at every seam, and the silhouette needs no jewelry to carry a room. Built for a single long evening.

products.name: Letterpress Corset & Leather Skirt
products.description: A boned corset top paired with a matching leather skirt, both in black. The corset structures the waist without a zipper up the back, and the leather skirt holds its shape through a night of standing. Two pieces built to be worn together.

products.name: Inkblack Corset & Skirt
products.description: A fitted corset and matching skirt set in matte black, boned through the bodice and finished with a hidden zip. The skirt falls to the knee in a heavier cotton-blend that holds pleats without pressing. A set built for a night that runs late.

products.name: Pea Coat Dress
products.description: A navy wool pea coat cut as a dress, double-breasted with a notched collar. The wool holds warmth through the coldest months, and the hem sits just above the knee for a coat that still reads as a dress. One piece for the entire winter.

products.name: Foldover Slipper, Black & Brown
products.description: A foldover slipper in black-and-brown leather, slipped on with no laces or straps. The sole is flexible enough to pack flat, and the leather softens with wear. Made for the walk between the front door and the car, not the mile after.

products.name: Gilt Edition Shoe
products.description: A dress shoe in gold-tone metallic leather, cut low with a slim heel. The finish reflects light without flaking, built to survive one long night rather than daily wear. A shoe for the one evening you want to be seen.

products.name: Pampi Walking Shoe
products.description: A walking shoe in white leather with a cushioned sole, built for distance rather than display. The upper is soft from the first wear, and the tread holds on wet pavement. Made for the days that involve a lot of standing.

products.name: Red Press Shoe
products.description: A pump in red patent leather, cut with a pointed toe and a mid-height heel. The patent finish holds a shine through a full day without scuffing, and the heel is low enough to walk city blocks in. A red shoe that still goes with everything else.

products.name: Blackout Sunglasses
products.description: A wraparound sunglass in matte black acetate, with lenses cut wide to block glare from every angle. The frame sits close to the face and doesn't slip on a run. Built for full sun, not a café table.

products.name: Classic Frame Sunglasses
products.description: A classic frame sunglass in tortoiseshell acetate, round-lensed and lightweight on the nose. The shape works for a narrow or wide face without pinching at the temple. An everyday pair for a bag or a jacket pocket.

products.name: Bicolour Frame Sunglasses
products.description: A bicolour sunglass in green-and-black acetate, with the two tones split across the frame's brow line. The frame sits close without pinching, built for daily wear from morning commute to afternoon errands. A pair with enough color to notice, not enough to shout.

products.name: Soirée Sunglasses
products.description: A cat-eye sunglass in glossy black acetate, angled up sharply at the outer corner. The frame is light enough for a full evening and catches the light at a bar or a rooftop. Built for after dark, not for driving.

products.name: Cerulean Handbag
products.description: A structured handbag in cerulean blue leather, with a top handle and a detachable strap. The leather holds its shape without slouching through a full workday, and the interior fits a laptop sleeve and the rest of a bag's usual contents. A blue that reads as neutral against black or camel.

products.name: Offset Backpack, Chalk
products.description: A backpack in chalk-white faux leather, with a padded strap and a laptop compartment lined in canvas. The faux leather wipes clean of most marks, unusual for a bag this light in colour. Built for a commute, not a hiking trail.

products.name: Colophon Handbag, Black
products.description: A structured handbag in black leather, with a flap closure and a gold-tone clasp. The leather is heavy enough to hold its shape empty, and the strap adjusts to wear crossbody or on the shoulder. A black bag built to be the only one you carry.

products.name: Colophon Drop Earring, Emerald
products.description: A faceted emerald crystal drop suspended from gold-tone brass. Light catches the facets at every angle, so it carries a plain outfit on its own. Weighs almost nothing on the ear.

products.name: Oval Signature Earring, Emerald
products.description: An oval-cut emerald crystal stud earring, set in gold-tone brass. The oval shape sits flat against the earlobe and doesn't catch on a scarf or collar. A quieter version of the drop, for daily wear.

products.name: Tropic Edition Earring
products.description: A statement earring in enamel-coated brass, shaped like a stylized palm leaf in green and gold. The piece is light despite its size and hangs still rather than swinging. A single bright note for a plain outfit.

products.name: Deadline Watch, Brown Leather
products.description: A wristwatch with a stainless case and a brown leather strap, worn through and buckled like a belt. The dial is legible at a glance across a newsroom desk, no unnecessary complications. Built to be checked constantly and never babied.

products.name: Masthead Wrist Watch
products.description: A wristwatch with a slim stainless case and a mesh steel strap, sized small enough for a narrow wrist. The face is plain white with thin hands and no date window to clutter it. A watch that reads formal without trying.

products.name: Gilt Masthead Watch
products.description: A wristwatch in gold-tone stainless steel, with a bracelet strap and a champagne dial. The finish is heavy enough to read as fine jewelry rather than a tool, and the bracelet adjusts with a hidden clasp. Suited to evening wear rather than a daily rotation.
